# vendor/ — third-party mirrors for CN-reliable delivery

All files are unmodified third-party releases except URL rewrites noted below.
Mirrored because GitHub Releases / raw.githubusercontent are unreliable on mainland cellular.

| file | upstream | version / fetched | license |
|---|---|---|---|
| sub-store-parser.loon.min.js | sub-store-org/Sub-Store releases/latest | 2026-11-20 snapshot | Apache-2.0 |
| iRingo.WeatherKit.lpx | NSRingo/WeatherKit releases v3.3.2 | 2026-08-29 release | MIT |
| wk-request.bundle.js | NSRingo/WeatherKit releases v3.3.2 | same | MIT |
| wk-response.bundle.js | NSRingo/WeatherKit releases v3.3.2 | same | MIT |

Modification: iRingo.WeatherKit.lpx script-path URLs rewritten from GitHub Releases
to this directory's Pages URLs (content otherwise unchanged).

Update procedure: re-download upstream release assets, re-apply URL rewrite, commit, push.
